name: Cloudflare Mesh
description: Cloudflare Mesh (formerly WARP Connector) runs the Cloudflare One Client headless as a Mesh node. It gives the container a private Mesh IP and can advertise LAN subnets, providing bidirectional TCP, UDP and ICMP connectivity between sites and enrolled devices through Cloudflare.

app_vars.name: var_mesh_token
app_vars.label: Mesh node token
app_vars.help: From Zero Trust > Networking > Mesh > Add node > Linux. Leave empty to enroll later with warp-cli.

notes.text: The Mesh node device profile must use MASQUE and route only 100.96.0.0/12 (Include mode). The dashboard wizard sets this up for new accounts.
Do not run this in the same container or host as cloudflared: the Mesh node captures outbound traffic and can break cloudflared's connections.
To reach a LAN subnet through this node, add a CIDR route to the node in the dashboard and point the LAN's return route for 100.96.0.0/12 at this container's IP.
